From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sergei Ivanov <s.ivanov@centrabank.com>, Elena Kozlova <e.kozlova@centrabank.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 15:02:00 -0400
Subject: Private VPC discovery recap — CentraBank next steps

Hi Sergei / Elena —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we’re aligned before we engage infra: 

Pain points / drivers you called out:
- Data residency & regulatory constraints: all customer PII must remain within EU jurisdiction (data-at-rest and in-transit).
- Air-gapped / limited egress environment in your secure DC — minimal outbound connections, strict firewall rules.
- HSM/KMS requirement for key material (FIPS compliance), and audit logging for inference requests.
- Low-latency inference requirement for branch/ATM lookups (sub-200ms target).

Business goals:
- Operate Redwood Private in a CentraBank-controlled VPC/on-prem cluster that satisfies regs.
- Predictable cost and scaling for peak day-of-month traffic.
- Ability to run model updates with canary rollouts and rollback.

Immediate technical constraints we captured:
- No direct outbound internet from the inference subnet.
- Allowlist-based NAT/proxy for external registry access during deploy windows only.
- Dedicated HSM appliance accessible via internal network.

Next steps we propose:
1) Technical deep-dive with your infra/networking team (Camila + Rishi to lead). Please share 2–3 available slots next week.
2) Share a minimal network requirements checklist (attached) and your network diagram if available.
3) If helpful, we can prepare 2 design options: (A) VPC with PrivateLink + egress-proxy for updates, (B) fully air-gapped on-prem installer that never touches public internet.

Attachments: centra_prelim_network_requirements.pdf

If I missed anything important, call it out and I’ll update the doc. Thanks — looking forward to the infra call.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Sergei Ivanov <s.ivanov@centrabank.com>

Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 09:15:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Private VPC discovery recap — CentraBank next steps

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear summary — that matches our notes. A few clarifications / additional constraints from infra: 

- Our secure DC has no outbound internet by default. We can provide a controlled egress path via a proxy/NAT for specific windows and registries (approve-by-change-window).
- Ports are highly restricted: only outbound TLS (443) via proxy, internal ports for HSM (TCP 1792) and SSH for maintenance via bastion.
- HSM is an on-prem Thales module; keys cannot leave the appliance. Any integration must support external KMS via internal network without exporting keys.
- Audit requirements: we need request-level logging and integration with our SIEM (Splunk).
- Compliance: we will require SOC 2 / ISO 27001 evidence and FIPS-140 certification for crypto components.

I attached our high-level network diagram and a short HSM spec.

We can do the infra deep-dive Tuesday 20 Apr 10:00–11:00 CET or Wednesday 21 Apr 14:00–15:00 CET. Which works for you?

Attachments: centrabank-network-diagram.png; centrabank-hsm-spec.pdf

Subject: Re: Private VPC discovery recap — CentraBank next steps

Hi Sergei / Elena —

Appreciate the specifics — that helps a lot. Based on your constraints we’ll prepare two implementation tracks and a short checklist for the infra call: 

Option A — Managed VPC w/ controlled egress:
- Redwood Private deployed into a CentraBank-managed VPC (customer VPC).
- Egress via approved proxy/NAT during signed maintenance windows for image pulls/patches.
- Mount HSM over internal network; Redwood will call KMS endpoints that proxy to your Thales appliance.
- SIEM integration for request logs (we can push logs to a Splunk HTTP Event Collector over internal network).

Option B — Air-gapped on-prem installer:
- On-prem installer bundle (no public registry access).
- We provide signed tarballs and hash verification; delivery via secure file handoff.
- All key operations bound to your HSM; Redwood runtime never exports keys.

Technical prerequisites we’ll need before the call:
- Network diagram (thanks for attaching) + list of approved egress registries (if Option A).
- IP ranges and ports for bastion/HSM/SIEM endpoints.
- Contact for HSM admin and Splunk engineer.

Proposed agenda for the infra deep-dive (30–45 min):
1) Quick intro and scope confirmation (5 min)
2) Review your network diagram & HSM connectivity (10–15 min)
3) Feasibility of Option A vs Option B and technical gaps (10–15 min)
4) Next steps & timeline (5 min)

I’ve uploaded a short design outline and internal install checklist here: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/centrabank-private-vpc-design (view-only).

Available slots: Tue 20 Apr 10:00–11:00 CET works for us (Camila + Rishi). I’ll send a calendar invite and a pre-call checklist for the infra team.

Attachments: redwood-private-onprem-outline.pdf

Thanks —
Camila Reyes
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
